scope.experience: The web translator's source/target text workflow
scope.task: Translate a short English paragraph into German, inspect the result, and choose wording alternatives where offered.
scope.configuration: Manual text input with source/target language selection; no API, continuous voice translation or automated translation workflow. No plan was tested.
scope.audience_perspective: An individual needing a translation in supported languages

conversational.rationale: Users work with source/target text and language controls rather than an ongoing open-ended dialogue.
conversational.uncertainty: Optional clarification or newer interfaces may add interaction; the core translation panes are the assessed experience.

specialization.rationale: Translation between languages is a narrowly defined task with task-specific controls and outputs.
specialization.uncertainty: A maximum specialization score describes task focus, not best-in-class translation quality.

autonomy.rationale: The translator produces a result from submitted text, while the user selects the text, language and whether to use the output.
autonomy.uncertainty: Automated publishing and integrated translation pipelines would have different autonomy.

accessibility.rationale: A straightforward web text-in/text-out interface supports a broad audience without coding or a specialized professional role.
accessibility.uncertainty: Supported language pairs, quotas and paid options constrain use; this is not a translation-accuracy or disability-accessibility test.

explainability.rationale: Side-by-side text and available alternatives expose the input and wording choices, but the translator does not provide a complete accountable explanation of each translation decision.
explainability.uncertainty: Users need language knowledge or a reviewer to judge correctness; alternatives are not proof of model reasoning.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-18; no live product tests or translation-quality measurements. Scope: DeepL web text translation with human review, excluding Voice, Write, API and automated pipelines. Scores are design estimates. Source: https://www.deepl.com/en/translator .
